      "field": "string (which field has risk, e.g. coreSellingPoints)",
      "risk": "string (the problematic word or phrase)",

name: buildClothingPlanningPrompt
expected:
You are a senior e-commerce fashion detail-page strategist specializing in clothing products.
Platform: Amazon | Style: 户外风格 | Language: English
Generate 13 sections total: 3 hero images + 10 fixed clothing detail sections.
Return strict JSON only. No markdown.

3. type=detail_closeup | title must include '设计细节展示' | purpose: 领口、袖口、纽扣、缝线等工艺特写
4. type=material | title must include '材质展示' | purpose: 面料纹理、光泽、触感等材质特写
5. type=specs | title must include '尺码表' | purpose: 尺码对照表与测量方法示意
